name: The Drowned City
summary: A scholar asks you to inspect ruins guarded by naga and copy their tablet etchings. The city may be I’lalai, rich in lost history.

sections.title: Across the Cavern
sections.body: The scholar is too old to enter the ruins, so you are asked to go in their stead. Beyond the cavern guarded by naga, the scholar suspects the ruins may be I’lalai. The lost city could hold a wealth of historical knowledge. You are to make rubbings of any tablets you find and bring them back.

faq.answer: The ruins may be the lost city of I’lalai, according to the scholar who sent you.

faq.q: Who wants me to explore the ruins?
faq.answer: A scholar asks you to explore the ruins because they are too old to go themselves.

faq.q: Why am I being sent there?
faq.answer: The scholar hopes the ruins hold a great wealth of lost historical knowledge.

faq.q: What am I supposed to bring back?
faq.answer: Make rubbings of any tablets you find using hide and charcoal, then return them to the scholar.
The ruins lie on the other side of the cavern guarded by naga.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Drowned City
